rows.title: A germinal products notification is certified for 'Germinal products' from the moment its draft is created
rows.detail: A trader starting a germinal products notification is never asked what the goods are certified for, because there is only one answer it can have. The draft is created with 'Germinal products' already stored, so the review shows it as settled information rather than something to answer, and the submitted notification carries it to the receiving system in the same certified-for clause a live animals notification uses. The policy page marks the certified-for field as affecting live animals only while still listing 'Germinal products' among its values; the owner's decision settles that it is held on a germinal products notification and set automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: A newly created germinal products notification's review page shows an 'Additional details' card holding one row, 'Certified for', reading 'Germinal products', before the trader has answered any journey page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-079)

The 'Certified for' row of a germinal products notification's review page shows the answer as plain text, with no Change link (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-020; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-079-m1)

Submitting a germinal products notification publishes the certified-for value 'Germinal products' in the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS declaration clause of its published event, seen in the admin's outbox events view (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019; confluence:6497338582 §Live Animal Data Elements row "Animals certified for")

sources.ref: §Live Animal Data Elements table, row "Animals certified for" (confluence-6497338582-p1-115, confluence-6497338582-p1-115-m1)

notes: One slice: the germinal half of the certified-for field (req-182). Its live half is a requirement of its own and sits in the commodities-and-reason theme's additional details work, so this row changes nothing on the live animals pages.

Already sits in inc-182 (the rest of the germinal journey, with req-1898 and req-1839): its review and published criteria need the germinal review and submit that row builds, so building it apart would repeat the same set-up, review and ladder. The combiner should keep inc-182's id, theme (germinal-products), dependencies and external dependencies, and merge this draft's criteria into it without repeats.

No backend change is expected: the notification record already stores certified-for as free text and the GBN-AG mapper already publishes it as the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS clause (req-1590, adopted as already met), so only the frontend sets the value at draft creation. Should a repo check at plan time find otherwise, the row gains the backend repo before the frontend.

Ordering need: the germinal products pages do not exist in the frontend today, so this cannot be observed until the germinal products set and its review page land. inc-182 already carries those dependencies.

The policy page's certified-for row marks the field as affecting live animals only yet lists 'Germinal products' among its 16 values (a gap claim). The owner's 9 October decision outranks the policy page and settles that a germinal products notification holds the field and is never asked for it, so no open question remains.
